collection.description: A wounded patient is losing strength, and an apprentice proposes transferring blood from a healthy volunteer.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A wounded patient is losing strength; an apprentice proposes transferring blood from a healthy volunteer, having seen a crude experiment with animals.

choices.label: Attempt the unfamiliar transfer with informed consent.
Use established measures to control bleeding and provide care.
Test the idea further without risking this patient.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient briefly rallies, then becomes feverish; the healers fear a harmful reaction.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient survives, but the healers cannot tell whether the transfer helped.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The bleeding slows, and the patient gradually recovers.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The wound proves too severe, and the patient dies despite careful treatment.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The apprentice discovers that blood from different animals does not behave alike.

c2__fx.name: Outcome C2
c2__fx.text: The healer records the proposal as too uncertain for immediate use.

c2__text.name: Outcome C2
c2__text.text: The healer records the proposal as too uncertain for immediate use.
